_PAGE_FILTER_DURATION_DESCRIPTION_: The function filterDuration formats a duration, e.g. of a process or a video: as text with units (1 h 2 min 5 s) or as a clock (01:02:05). The value is rounded to whole seconds.
_PAGE_FILTER_DURATION_ARGUMENTS_SOURCE_U: The units of the value: ms, s, m, h or d
_PAGE_FILTER_DURATION_ARGUMENTS_MAX_UNIT: Only for long: the maximum number of shown units, starting with the largest one. 0 shows all units
_PAGE_FILTER_DURATION_ARGUMENTS_SHOW_DAY: Only for long: whether days are shown. Otherwise they are counted as hours
